question: Where must all deities be worshipped to avoid futile external ritual effort?
premises: All deities are to be worshipped.
The locus of worship is the middle of suṣumnā.
The locus is also identified with the vital breath.
inference: One should worship all deities in the vital breath within the middle of suṣumnā.
plain_english: One should worship all the deities in the vital breath within the middle of the suṣumnā.
